public_rationale: Both companies announced financing at the scale Zitron describes. That establishes fundraising activity, not the claimed dependence of most AI compute revenue on continued annual fundraising. The decisive missing evidence is a comparable sector revenue breakdown and a cash-flow bridge showing how much outside funding is necessary to sustain the two companies' purchases. Neither the 70%–90% share nor the recurring financing requirement is established.
limitations: Funding, revenue, annualized revenue and multiyear compute commitments are different measures.
One neocloud's customer concentration cannot establish the sector-wide share.
The available evidence does not justify a separate conclusion that either company is financially sustainable.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The vast majority of AI data center compute revenue is contingent on two unprofitable, unsustainable AI companies continuing to be able to raise tens or hundreds of billions of dollars a year.

statement.excerpt: To be abundantly clear, the vast majority of the AI data center compute revenue is contingent on the continued ability of two unprofitable, unsustainable AI companies’ to raise tens or hundreds of billions of dollars a year.

from_speaker: to raise tens or hundreds of billions of dollars a year
70% to 90% of that demand is from Anthropic and OpenAI
our_interpretation: The two companies are OpenAI and Anthropic, identified in the surrounding text.
The ordinary reading concerns realized revenue earned by AI compute providers, including hyperscalers and neoclouds, rather than model-company revenue or hardware sales.
The contextual 70%–90% estimate guides the meaning of vast majority; it is not treated as an independently established measurement.
Use January through March 2026, the latest completed quarter ordinarily reportable before the July post.
Dependence requires evidence that continuing compute purchases need external financing at the stated annual scale. A large funding round alone does not establish that requirement.
Unsustainable is read as unable to maintain the stated spending without outside funds, rather than certain eventual failure.
The accounting basis is estimate because the surrounding passage constructs an assumed sector-demand total rather than citing consolidated sector accounts.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable provider revenue data establish an overwhelming share attributable to OpenAI and Anthropic, and cash-flow evidence establishes dependence on recurring external financing of tens or hundreds of billions of dollars annually.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable data establish a substantially smaller dependent revenue share, or establish that continuing the relevant purchases does not require external financing at the claimed scale.
